lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 東賢，你姊姊是不是又計畫去旅行了？
lines.simplified: 东贤，你姊姊是不是又计划去旅行了？
lines.pinyin: Dōngxián, nǐ jiějie shì bú shì yòu jìhuà qù lǚxíng le?
lines.english: Dongxian, is your older sister planning another trip again?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 沒錯。她正準備去非洲大草原。
lines.simplified: 没错。她正准备去非洲大草原。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò. Tā zhèng zhǔnbèi qù Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán.
lines.english: That's right. She's just getting ready to go to the African savanna.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 我常看她部落格裡的背包客日記，不但內容充實、想法獨特，而且跟旅遊相關的建議也寫得很詳細，讓我打開了視野。
lines.simplified: 我常看她部落格里的背包客日记，不但内容充实、想法独特，而且跟旅游相关的建议也写得很详细，让我打开了视野。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cháng kàn tā bùluògé lǐ de bēibāokè rìjì, búdàn nèiróng chōngshí, xiǎngfǎ dútè, érqiě gēn lǚyóu xiāngguān de jiànyì yě xiě de hěn xiángxì, ràng wǒ dǎkāi le shìyě.
lines.english: I often read the backpacker diary on her blog. Not only is the content substantial and original, but the travel tips are written in great detail, which broadened my horizons.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我姊姊真的很厲害，一個人上山下海到處旅行。數一數，她已經去過三十幾個國家了。因為她的關係，我也對旅行產生了興趣，上個月她來臺灣時，我們還一起騎自行車環島呢！
lines.simplified: 我姊姊真的很厉害，一个人上山下海到处旅行。数一数，她已经去过三十几个国家了。因为她的关系，我也对旅行产生了兴趣，上个月她来台湾时，我们还一起骑自行车环岛呢！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie zhēnde hěn lìhai, yì ge rén shàngshān xiàhǎi dàochù lǚxíng. Shǔ yì shǔ, tā yǐjīng qù guò sānshí jǐ ge guójiā le. Yīnwèi tā de guānxì, wǒ yě duì lǚxíng chǎnshēng le xìngqù, shàng ge yuè tā lái Táiwān shí, wǒmen hái yìqǐ qí zìxíngchē huándǎo ne!
lines.english: My sister is truly amazing, traveling everywhere by herself from mountains to seas. Counting them up, she's visited over thirty countries. Because of her, I also got interested in travel; when she came to Taiwan last month, we even cycled around the island together!

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 真好。我猜，這次的環島旅行一定讓你姊姊很難忘吧？
lines.simplified: 真好。我猜，这次的环岛旅行一定让你姊姊很难忘吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo. Wǒ cāi, zhè cì de huándǎo lǚxíng yídìng ràng nǐ jiějie hěn nánwàng ba?
lines.english: How wonderful. I bet this island-cycling trip was unforgettable for your sister?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 唉，怎麼說呢？我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
lines.simplified: 唉，怎么说呢？我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
lines.pinyin: Ài, zěnme shuō ne? Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
lines.english: Well, how should I put it? We originally planned a 10-day trip, but unfortunately it ended after just 6 days.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 怎麼回事？
lines.simplified: 怎么回事？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme huí shì?
lines.english: What happened?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 我們的運氣很差，碰到了壞天氣。出發前，氣象預報說那幾天都是晴天。頭幾天的天氣很好，誰知道到了第六天，一到山區天空就突然變黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都濕了，自行車也壞了。
lines.simplified: 我们的运气很差，碰到了坏天气。出发前，气象预报说那几天都是晴天。头几天的天气很好，谁知道到了第六天，一到山区天空就突然变黑，也下起了大雨，我的衣服都湿了，自行车也坏了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen de yùnqì hěn chà, pèngdào le huài tiānqì. Chūfā qián, qìxiàng yùbào shuō nà jǐ tiān dōu shì qíngtiān. Tóu jǐ tiān de tiānqì hěn hǎo, shéi zhīdào dào le dì-liù tiān, yí dào shānqū tiānkōng jiù tūrán biàn hēi, yě xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒ de yīfu dōu shī le, zìxíngchē yě huài le.
lines.english: Our luck was terrible; we ran into bad weather. Before leaving, the weather forecast said those days would all be sunny. The first few days were great, but on the sixth day, as soon as we hit the mountains the sky turned black and heavy rain poured down. My clothes were soaked and my bike broke down.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 那真糟糕！不過山區的天氣本來變化就很大，有時山下還是晴天，山上已經變涼，甚至起風、下雨了。後來你們怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那真糟糕！不过山区的天气本来变化就很大，有时山下还是晴天，山上已经变凉，甚至起风、下雨了。后来你们怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zhēn zāogāo! Búguò shānqū de tiānqì běnlái biànhuà jiù hěn dà, yǒushí shānxià háishì qíngtiān, shānshàng yǐjīng biàn liáng, shènzhì qǐfēng, xiàyǔ le. Hòulái nǐmen zěnme bàn?
lines.english: That's awful! But mountain weather changes a lot naturally; sometimes it's still sunny at the foot of the mountain while cool, windy, or rainy up top. What did you do then?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 那時，我們的手機訊號很弱，一直連絡不到能修理的人，只好推著自行車走了很長的一段路。
lines.simplified: 那时，我们的手机讯号很弱，一直连络不到能修理的人，只好推着自行车走了很长的一段路。
lines.pinyin: Nà shí, wǒmen de shǒujī xùnhào hěn ruò, yìzhí liánluò bú dào néng xiūlǐ de rén, zhǐhǎo tuī zhe zìxíngchē zǒu le hěn cháng de yí duàn lù.
lines.english: Back then our cell reception was very weak and we couldn't reach anyone to repair it, so we had no choice but to push the bikes along a long stretch of road.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 附近沒有商店嗎？有沒有車子經過？
lines.simplified: 附近没有商店吗？有没有车子经过？
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn méiyǒu shāngdiàn ma? Yǒu méiyǒu chēzi jīngguò?
lines.english: Were there no shops nearby? Did any cars pass by?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 那是在偏僻的山區，附近什麼都沒有。還好後來遇到一個當地人，他幫我們把車修好。沒想到那時候我姊姊突然發燒了，我們不得不縮短行程，趕快下山去醫院。
lines.simplified: 那是在偏僻的山区，附近什么都没有。还好后来遇到一个当地人，他帮我们把车修好。没想到那时候我姊姊突然发烧了，我们不得不缩短行程，赶快下山去医院。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì zài piānpì de shānqū, fùjìn shénme dōu méiyǒu. Hái hǎo hòulái yùdào yí ge dāngdì rén, tā bāng wǒmen bǎ chē xiū hǎo. Méi xiǎngdào nà shíhou wǒ jiějie tūrán fāshāo le, wǒmen bùdébù suōduǎn xíngchéng, gǎnkuài xiàshān qù yīyuàn.
lines.english: It was in a remote mountain area with nothing around. Fortunately we ran into a local who fixed our bike. Little did we expect my sister suddenly ran a fever, so we had to cut the trip short and hurry down the mountain to the hospital.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 聽起來這次的旅行不太順利。不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
lines.simplified: 听起来这次的旅行不太顺利。不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlai zhè cì de lǚxíng bú tài shùnlì. Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bú quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
lines.english: Sounds like this trip wasn't very smooth. But then again, it's precisely because you never know what you'll encounter that travel is so enchanting.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 沒錯，我姊姊也是這麼說的。
lines.simplified: 没错，我姊姊也是这么说的。
lines.pinyin: Méicuò, wǒ jiějie yě shì zhème shuō de.
lines.english: Exactly; my sister said so too.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 你姊姊這次去非洲，還是一個人去嗎？有個人陪比較好吧。
lines.simplified: 你姊姊这次去非洲，还是一个人去吗？有个人陪比较好吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie zhè cì qù Fēizhōu, háishì yí ge rén qù ma? Yǒu ge rén péi bǐjiào hǎo ba.
lines.english: Is your sister going to Africa by herself again this time? It might be better to have someone accompany her.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 她早就習慣一個人旅行了，想去哪裡就去哪裡，不必在意別人的想法。再說，她的旅行經驗這麼豐富，一個人去絕對沒問題的。像規劃行程、辦簽證，上網查當地的氣溫、地形等等，對她來說，都是小事。
lines.simplified: 她早就习惯一个人旅行了，想去哪里就去哪里，不必在意别人的想法。再说，她的旅行经验这么丰富，一个人去绝对没问题的。像规划行程、办签证，上网查当地的气温、地形等等，对她来说，都是小事。
lines.pinyin: Tā zǎojiù xíguàn yí ge rén lǚxíng le, xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ, bú bì zàiyì biérén de xiǎngfǎ. Zàishuō, tā de lǚxíng jīngyàn zhème fēngfù, yí ge rén qù juéduì méi wèntí de. Xiàng guīhuà xíngchéng, bàn qiānzhèng, shàngwǎng chá dāngdì de qìwēn, dìxíng děngděng, duì tā lái shuō, dōu shì xiǎoshì.
lines.english: She's long used to solo travel: going wherever she wants without having to care about others' opinions. Besides, with her rich travel experience, going alone is no problem at all. Planning itineraries, applying for visas, checking weather and terrain online—to her, these are all easy.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
lines.simplified: 这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bu chéng de?
lines.english: So that means, wherever she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她認為只有走出舒服的生活環境，才能發現不一樣的自己。
lines.simplified: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她认为只有走出舒服的生活环境，才能发现不一样的自己。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ jiějie yǒu bēibāokè de xìnggé, tā rènwéi zhǐyǒu zǒuchū shūfu de shēnghuó huánjìng, cái néng fāxiàn bù yíyàng de zìjǐ.
lines.english: Yeah. My sister has the spirit of a backpacker; she believes only by stepping out of one's comfort zone can one discover a different self.

lines.speaker: 明哲
lines.traditional: 難怪你姊姊的背包客日記，內容總是那麼吸引人。
lines.simplified: 难怪你姊姊的背包客日记，内容总是那么吸引人。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ jiějie de bēibāokè rìjì, nèiróng zǒngshì nàme xīyǐnrén.
lines.english: No wonder her backpacker diary is always so captivating.

lines.speaker: 東賢
lines.traditional: 對了，你不是剛跟女朋友分開了嗎？要是你因為失戀而覺得很痛苦，就當個背包客出去走走吧。
lines.simplified: 对了，你不是刚跟女朋友分开了吗？要是你因为失恋而觉得很痛苦，就当个背包客出去走走吧。
lines.pinyin: Duì le, nǐ bú shì gāng gēn nǚpéngyou fēnkāi le ma? Yàoshi nǐ yīnwèi shīliàn ér juéde hěn tòngkǔ, jiù dāng ge bēibāokè chūqù zǒuzou ba.
lines.english: By the way, didn't you just break up with your girlfriend? If you're hurting from the heartbreak, why not go on a backpacking trip to clear your head?

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a short time, small quantity, or quick result with 才……就……, and show surprise.
grammarPages.explanation:
(1)「才……（，）就……」：「才」在這裡強調時間短、不久，或是數量少、次數少、程度低，後面和「就」一起使用；「就」的後面表示接著出現的事實，但是說話的人對這樣的情況感到驚訝。例如：你不是很餓嗎？怎麼才吃一碗就飽了？這句話的意思是，說話的人覺得你應該要吃兩、三碗，只吃一碗太少了。
(2)「才……（，）就……」：「才」是「剛剛」的意思，表示「才」後面的事情剛剛發生，「就」後面的事情是緊接著發生的。例如：我才出門就下雨了。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
(1) 才……（，）就……: 才 here emphasizes that the time is short, or the number is small, the frequency is less often, and the level is low. 才 is used together with 就 in the second part to indicate the fact that follows, but the speaker feels surprised with this situation. For example, 你不是很餓嗎？怎麼才吃一碗飯就飽了？ The meaning of this sentence is that the speaker thinks that you should eat two or three bowls, but only one bowl is not enough!
(2) 才……（，）就……: 才 means "just now", which means that the action described after 才 just happened, and the action described after 就 happened immediately afterwards. For example, 我才出門就下雨了。

text.traditional: 我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
text.simplified: 我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxī cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
text.english: We originally planned a ten-day trip, but it ended after only six days.

text.traditional: 小馬的工作能力很強，生意越做越大，才二十幾歲就已經是三家公司的老闆了。
text.simplified: 小马的工作能力很强，生意越做越大，才二十几岁就已经是三家公司的老板了。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, shēngyi yuè zuò yuè dà, cái èrshí jǐ suì jiù yǐjīng shì sān jiā gōngsī de lǎobǎn le.
text.english: Xiao Ma works very capably and his business keeps growing; he is only in his twenties and already the boss of three companies.

text.traditional: 弟弟才剛畢業就立刻找到了一份好工作，運氣真好。
text.simplified: 弟弟才刚毕业就立刻找到了一份好工作，运气真好。
text.pinyin: Dìdi cái gāng bìyè jiù lìkè zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò, yùnqi zhēn hǎo.
text.english: My younger brother had just graduated and immediately found a good job; he is really lucky.

text.traditional: 你才剛從歐洲旅行回來，就開始安排去非洲旅遊的計畫，不累嗎？
text.simplified: 你才刚从欧洲旅行回来，就开始安排去非洲旅游的计划，不累吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ cái gāng cóng Ōuzhōu lǚxíng huílai, jiù kāishǐ ānpái qù Fēizhōu lǚyóu de jìhuà, bú lèi ma?
text.english: You have just come back from a trip to Europe and already you are planning a trip to Africa; aren't you tired?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 才 and 就 to show a quick or small result.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.

items.question: How does 才……就 differ from 剛……就?
items.answer: 才……就 emphasizes surprising brevity, small quantity, or earliness. 剛……就 merely denotes that an event just took place temporally.
items.wrongTraditional: 他剛學了三天就說得非常好。
items.wrongSimplified: 他刚学了三天就说得非常好。

right.traditional: 他才學了三天就說得非常好。
right.simplified: 他才学了三天就说得非常好。
right.pinyin: Tā cái xué le sān tiān jiù shuō de fēicháng hǎo.
right.english: He studied for only three days and already speaks very well.

items.question: Can 就 be omitted in the 才……就 structure?
items.answer: No, 就 connects the surprising premise (marked by 才) to the resulting rapid event or state.

right.traditional: 我才出門就下起雨來了。
right.simplified: 我才出门就下起雨来了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ cái chūmén jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
right.english: No sooner had I stepped out the door than it started raining.

questions.prompt: Express surprise at how fast a phone ran out of battery:

segments.hint: barely used an hour and already

tiles.pinyin: cái yòng le yì xiǎoshí jiù

questions.correctFeedback: 才……就 highlights the unexpectedly short duration before running out of power.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 才……就 to emphasize unexpected brevity.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a different opinion or return to the main point with 話說回來.
grammarPages.explanation: 跟別人對話時，說話的人雖然不反對對方的說法，但是，自己有不同的意見或更有道理的想法，這個時候就可以在「話說回來」的後面說明。也可以使用「話說回來」把談話的主題拉回來，並表達對這個話題最主要的意見。「話說回來」前面常加「不過、可是、但是」等詞。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 話說回來 is used when talking to others. Although the person speaking does not oppose the other person's ideas, he still has different opinions or more reasonable ideas. At this time, he can use 話說回來 then explain his opinion. 話說回來 can also be used to return to the topic of the conversation and express the most basic opinions on this topic. The words 不過, 可是 or 但是 are often added in front of 話說回來.

columns.traditional: 網路上的資料不一定都是對的
columns.simplified: 网路上的资料不一定都是对的
columns.pinyin: wǎnglù shàng de zīliào bù yídìng dōu shì duì de
columns.meaning: online information is not always correct

columns.traditional: 你不是說方便比什麼都重要
columns.simplified: 你不是说方便比什么都重要
columns.pinyin: nǐ bú shì shuō fāngbiàn bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào

text.traditional: ……不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
text.simplified: ……不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
text.pinyin: …… Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bù quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
text.english: …However, looking at it another way, it is precisely because you are not sure what you will run into that travel is so fascinating.

text.traditional:
A：上網找資料不僅方便，還可以找到其他相關的資料。
B：是啊。不過話說回來，網路上的資料不一定都是對的。
text.simplified:
A：上网找资料不仅方便，还可以找到其他相关的资料。
B：是啊。不过话说回来，网路上的资料不一定都是对的。
text.pinyin:
A: Shàngwǎng zhǎo zīliào bùjǐn fāngbiàn, hái kěyǐ zhǎodào qítā xiāngguān de zīliào.
B: Shì a. Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù shàng de zīliào bù yídìng dōu shì duì de.
text.english:
A: Looking for information online is not only convenient, you can also find other related information.
B: Yes. But then again, not all information online is necessarily correct.

text.traditional:
A：住在捷運站附近，方便是方便，不過噪音太大，讓我沒辦法好好休息。
B：可是話說回來，你不是說方便比什麼都重要，所以才搬到那裡去住的嗎？
text.simplified:
A：住在捷运站附近，方便是方便，不过噪音太大，让我没办法好好休息。
B：可是话说回来，你不是说方便比什么都重要，所以才搬到那里去住的吗？
text.pinyin:
A: Zhù zài jiéyùn zhàn fùjìn, fāngbiàn shì fāngbiàn, búguò zàoyīn tài dà, ràng wǒ méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo xiūxi.
B: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, nǐ bú shì shuō fāngbiàn bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào, suǒyǐ cái bān dào nàlǐ qù zhù de ma?
text.english:
A: Living near the MRT station is convenient, but the noise is too loud and I can't rest properly.
B: But then again, didn't you say convenience matters more than anything, which is why you moved there?

items.question: What function does 話說回來 perform in conversation?
items.answer: It introduces a balanced, realistic counter-point without directly attacking or invalidating the other person's earlier observation.
items.wrongTraditional: 不過總而言之，網路資料不全對。
items.wrongSimplified: 不过总而言之，网路资料不全对。

right.traditional: 不過話說回來，網路資料不全對。
right.simplified: 不过话说回来，网路资料不全对。
right.pinyin: Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù zīliào bù quán duì.
right.english: Then again, web information is not entirely accurate.

items.question: What conjunctions usually precede 話說回來?
items.answer: Adversative words such as 不過, 可是, or 但是.
items.wrongTraditional: 因為話說回來，旅行也是很危險的。
items.wrongSimplified: 因为话说回来，旅行也是很危险的。

right.traditional: 可是話說回來，旅行也是很危險的。
right.simplified: 可是话说回来，旅行也是很危险的。
right.pinyin: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, lǚxíng yě shì hěn wēixiǎn de.
right.english: Then again, traveling can also be very dangerous.

questions.prompt: Introduce a balanced counter-perspective acknowledging the initial point:

segments.hint: then again / on the other hand

questions.correctFeedback: 不過話說回來 smoothly pivots to the other side of the coin.
questions.repairFeedback: 話說回來 pairs with adversatives like 不過 to introduce a counter-perspective.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: So, Based on What You Said…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Draw a conclusion from what the other person just said with 這麼說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「這麼說」是「按照你說的情況來看」的意思。「這麼說」的後面是說話的人根據對方說的內容，表達自己的推斷。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 這麼說 means 如果按照你說的情況來看(If, according to what you have said...). After 這麼說, the speaker expresses his own inferences based on what the other party has said.

columns.meaning: no matter where she wants to go

columns.traditional: 小張的雙胞胎孩子快滿月
columns.simplified: 小张的双胞胎孩子快满月

明哲：這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？

text.english:

Mingzhe: So, no matter where she wants to go, there is nowhere she cannot go?

text.traditional:
A：小張的雙胞胎孩子快滿月了。

text.simplified:

B: So, he will be treating his colleagues to oil rice and red eggs.

text.traditional:
A：氣象預報說，強烈颱風明天會經過臺灣東北部，民眾出門時得小心。
B：這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
text.simplified:
A：气象预报说，强烈台风明天会经过台湾东北部，民众出门时得小心。
B：这么说，明天可能会放台风假喔！
text.pinyin:
A: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, qiángliè táifēng míngtiān huì jīngguò Táiwān dōngběi bù, mínzhòng chūmén shí děi xiǎoxīn.
B: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià o!
text.english:
A: The weather forecast says a strong typhoon will pass through northeastern Taiwan tomorrow, so people should be careful when going out.
B: So tomorrow may be a typhoon day off!

tomorrow may be a typhoon day off

items.question: How does 這麼說 differ from 也就是說?
items.answer: 這麼說 draws a tentative deduction from someone else's statement. 也就是說 restates or clarifies the same meaning in other words.
items.wrongTraditional: 也就是說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
items.wrongSimplified: 也就是说，明天可能会放台风假喔！

right.traditional: 這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
right.simplified: 这么说，明天可能会放台风假喔！
right.pinyin: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià o!
right.english: In that case, tomorrow might be a typhoon day off!

items.question: What position does 這麼說 take in a sentence?
items.answer: It stands at the beginning of the responsive turn, preceding the speaker's deduction.
items.wrongTraditional: 明天可能會放颱風假，這麼說！
items.wrongSimplified: 明天可能会放台风假，这么说！

right.traditional: 這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假！
right.simplified: 这么说，明天可能会放台风假！
right.pinyin: Zhème shuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià!
right.english: In that case, tomorrow might be a typhoon day off!

questions.prompt: Draw a conclusion after someone drank espresso late:
questions.correctFeedback: 這麼說 naturally introduces the logical conclusion based on their coffee intake.
questions.repairFeedback: 這麼說 begins a deductive inference from the speaker's premise.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Verb + 成 (Completed / Not Completed / Possible / Impossible)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether an action was completed or whether it is possible with V 成.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」是結果補語，有成功、完成、實現的意思。「V 成」表示動作已經完成、實現了；「沒 V 成」表示沒有完成、實現，用在已經發生的情況；「V 得成」、「V 不成」表示有或沒有完成、實現的可能性。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 成 is the result complement, with the meaning of success, completion, and realization. V 成 means that the action has been completed or realized; 沒 V 成 means that the action has not been completed or accomplished. V 得成, V 不成 means the possibility of completion or realization is uncertain.
grammarPages.pattern: V 成 / 沒 V 成 / V 得成 / V 不成

text.traditional: ……不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
text.simplified: ……不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
text.pinyin: …… Bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bù chéng de?
text.english: …No matter where she wants to go, is there anywhere she cannot go?

text.traditional: 氣象預報說明天下雨的機會是百分之九十，明天的跨年活動恐怕辦不成了。

text.simplified: 我们跟那家大公司的生意，今天终于谈成了，老板要请大家吃大餐，庆祝一下。

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 成 to show completion, failure, or possibility.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentences with V 成, 沒 V 成, V 得成 or V 不成.

items.question: How does 沒V成 differ from V不成?
items.answer: 沒V成 refers to an action in the past that failed to materialize. V不成 indicates an ongoing or future impossibility.
items.wrongTraditional: 昨天的戶外音樂會，我們辦不成了。
items.wrongSimplified: 昨天的户外音乐会，我们办不成了。

right.traditional: 昨天的戶外音樂會，我們沒辦成。
right.simplified: 昨天的户外音乐会，我们没办成。
right.pinyin: Zuótiān de hùwài yīnyuèhuì, wǒmen méi bànchéng.
right.english: Yesterday's outdoor concert we didn't manage to hold.

items.question: What does V得成 express?
items.answer: V得成 expresses affirmative potential—that an action has the feasible capability to succeed.
items.wrongTraditional: 提早兩小時排隊，絕對買不成烤鴨。
items.wrongSimplified: 提早两小时排队，绝对买不成烤鸭。

right.traditional: 提早兩小時排隊，絕對買得成烤鴨。
right.simplified: 提早两小时排队，绝对买得成烤鸭。
right.pinyin: Tízǎo liǎng xiǎoshí páiduì, juéduì mǎi de chéng kǎoyā.
right.english: Line up two hours early and you will definitely succeed in buying roast duck.

questions.prompt: Express that a business deal was successfully finalized:
questions.correctFeedback: 談成了 indicates the negotiations were successfully concluded.
questions.repairFeedback: V成 signals successful realization of the action.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁的好兄弟尚恩在臺灣學習中文，他常寄臺灣的明信片給馬丁。明信片上有的是有名的景點，像臺北101、太魯閣、孔廟；有的是臺灣文化的代表，像寺廟、歌仔戲、夜市小吃等等。
lines.simplified: 马丁的好兄弟尚恩在台湾学习中文，他常寄台湾的明信片给马丁。明信片上有的是有名的景点，像台北101、太鲁阁、孔庙；有的是台湾文化的代表，像寺庙、歌仔戏、夜市小吃等等。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng de hǎo xiōngdì Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, tā cháng jì Táiwān de míngxìnpiàn gěi Mǎdīng. Míngxìnpiàn shàng yǒudeshì yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, xiàng Táiběi 101, Tàilǔgé, Kǒngmiào; yǒudeshì Táiwān wénhuà de dàibiǎo, xiàng sìmiào, gēzǎixì, yèshì xiǎochī děngděng.
lines.english: Narrator: Martin's close pal Shawn was studying Chinese in Taiwan and often mailed Taiwan postcards to Martin. Some depicted famous attractions like Taipei 101, Taroko Gorge, and the Confucius Temple; others represented Taiwanese culture, such as temples, Taiwanese opera, and night market snacks.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁常聽尚恩提到跟臺灣相關的事。比如，臺灣曾經是荷蘭和日本等國家的殖民地；臺灣人和中國人都說中文，可是有一些詞的用法不太一樣；就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同，不過願意服務民眾的人，都比較容易當選。
lines.simplified: 马丁常听尚恩提到跟台湾相关的事。比如，台湾曾经是荷兰和日本等国家的殖民地；台湾人和中国人都说中文，可是有一些词的用法不太一样；就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同，不过愿意服务民众的人，都比较容易当选。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng cháng tīng Shàng'ēn tídào gēn Táiwān xiāngguān de shì. Bǐrú, Táiwān céngjīng shì Hélán hé Rìběn děng guójiā de zhímíndì; Táiwānrén hé Zhōngguórén dōu shuō Zhōngwén, kěshì yǒu yìxiē cí de yòngfǎ bú tài yíyàng; jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bù tóng, búguò yuànyì fúwù mínzhòng de rén, dōu bǐjiào róngyì dāngxuǎn.
lines.english: Martin often heard Shawn mention matters regarding Taiwan. For example, Taiwan had once been a colony of the Netherlands and Japan; both Taiwanese and mainland Chinese speak Chinese, but certain word usages differ; in terms of election culture, Taiwan and France are very different, though those willing to serve the public are more likely to get elected.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 馬丁覺得尚恩在臺灣的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要親自來確認一下，看看這個島是不是真的像尚恩說的那樣有意思。最近馬丁的工作不太順利，所以他決定給自己放個假，到離法國約一萬公里以外的臺灣走走。不僅要嚐嚐小吃，還計畫一個人騎自行車環島旅行。
lines.simplified: 马丁觉得尚恩在台湾的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要亲自来确认一下，看看这个岛是不是真的像尚恩说的那样有意思。最近马丁的工作不太顺利，所以他决定给自己放个假，到离法国约一万公里以外的台湾走走。不仅要尝尝小吃，还计划一个人骑自行车环岛旅行。
lines.pinyin: Mǎdīng juéde Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn yǒu yìsi, tā xiǎng, yǒu yì tiān yídìng yào qīnzì lái quèrèn yíxià, kànkan zhè ge dǎo shì bú shì zhēnde xiàng Shàng'ēn shuō de nàyàng yǒu yìsi. Zuìjìn Mǎdīng de gōngzuò bú tài shùnlì, suǒyǐ tā juédìng gěi zìjǐ fàng ge jià, dào lí Fǎguó yuē yí wàn gōnglǐ yǐwài de Táiwān zǒuzou. Bùjǐn yào chángchang xiǎochī, hái jìhuà yí ge rén qí zìxíngchē huándǎo lǚxíng.
lines.english: Martin found Shawn's life in Taiwan fascinating and felt that one day he must come personally verify if this island was really as intriguing as Shawn described. Recently Martin's work wasn't going smoothly, so he decided to take a holiday and visit Taiwan, some 10,000 kilometers away from France. He planned not only to taste local snacks, but also to cycle around the island alone.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 其實馬丁剛到臺灣時，還忘不了工作的問題，所以心情不太好。但是，當他在東部又寬又平的公路上，邊騎著自行車，邊欣賞美麗的風景時，他忽然覺得就像在天堂一樣，太美好、太值得了！還有一次，馬丁坐在椅子上，很專心地看著寺廟前的歌仔戲表演。演員演出時，剛好穿著和明信片上一樣的服裝，那種熟悉的感覺讓他很興奮，立刻拿起相機拍了起來。這段時間他也認識了一些樂觀、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、開玩笑，讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。馬丁覺得在臺灣經驗過的這些美好生活，就是這次旅行最珍貴的紀念。
lines.simplified: 其实马丁刚到台湾时，还忘不了工作的问题，所以心情不太好。但是，当他在东部又宽又平的公路上，边骑着自行车，边欣赏美丽的风景时，他忽然觉得就像在天堂一样，太美好、太值得了！还有一次，马丁坐在椅子上，很专心地看着寺庙前的歌仔戏表演。演员演出时，刚好穿着和明信片上一样的服装，那种熟悉的感觉让他很兴奋，立刻拿起相机拍了起来。这段时间他也认识了一些乐观、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、开玩笑，让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。马丁觉得在台湾经验过的这些美好生活，就是这次旅行最珍贵的纪念。
lines.pinyin: Qíshí Mǎdīng gāng dào Táiwān shí, hái wàng buliǎo gōngzuò de wèntí, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bú tài hǎo. Dànshì, dāng tā zài dōngbù yòu kuān yòu píng de gōnglù shàng, biān qí zhe zìxíngchē, biān xīnshǎng měilì de fēngjǐng shí, tā hūrán juéde jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yíyàng, tài měihǎo, tài zhídé le! Hái yǒu yí cì, Mǎdīng zuò zài yǐzi shàng, hěn zhuānxīn de kàn zhe sìmiào qián de gēzǎixì biǎoyǎn. Yǎnyuán yǎnchū shí, gānghǎo chuān zhe hé míngxìnpiàn shàng yíyàng de fúzhuāng, nà zhǒng shóuxī de gǎnjué ràng tā hěn xīngfèn, lìkè ná qǐ xiàngjī pāi le qǐlai. Zhè duàn shíjiān tā yě rènshí le yìxiē lèguān, yōumò de péngyou, dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān, kāiwánxiào, ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàng le. Mǎdīng juéde zài Táiwān jīngyàn guò de zhèxiē měihǎo shēnghuó, jiùshì zhè cì lǚxíng zuì zhēnguì de jìniàn.
lines.english: Actually when Martin first arrived, he couldn't put work troubles out of mind and was in a low mood. But as he cycled along wide flat highways in eastern Taiwan while admiring the breathtaking scenery, he suddenly felt like he was in paradise—it was wonderful and so worthwhile! Another time, sitting on a chair, he watched a Taiwanese opera performance in front of a temple attentively. The actors were dressed in the exact costumes shown on the postcards; that familiar feeling thrilled him, and he immediately snapped photos. During this trip he also befriended optimistic, humorous companions whose chats and jokes made him forget his work stress. Martin felt these wonderful experiences were the most precious souvenirs of the trip.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 經過這趟豐富的旅行後，馬丁的心情好多了，想法也改變了。回到法國後，到底要換新工作，還是要克服困難勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳選擇，讓生活過得更充實、更有意義。
lines.simplified: 经过这趟丰富的旅行后，马丁的心情好多了，想法也改变了。回到法国后，到底要换新工作，还是要克服困难勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳选择，让生活过得更充实、更有意义。
lines.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè tàng fēngfù de lǚxíng hòu, Mǎdīng de xīnqíng hǎo duō le, xiǎngfǎ yě gǎibiàn le. Huí dào Fǎguó hòu, dàodǐ yào huàn xīn gōngzuò, háishì yào kèfú kùnnan yǒnggǎn zǒu xiàqu, tā xiāngxìn zìjǐ yídìng néng zuòchū zuìjiā xuǎnzé, ràng shēnghuó guò de gèng chōngshí, gèng yǒu yìyì.
lines.english: After this enriching journey, Martin felt much better and his outlook shifted. Upon returning to France, whether to switch jobs or face difficulties bravely, he was confident he could make the best choice to make his life more fulfilling and meaningful.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Narrow a comment to one object or scope with 就……來說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「就……來說」常用在書面，「就」有針對的意思。主要針對某個對象或某個範圍來敘述或分析。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就……來說 is often used in written Chinese. 就 has a targeted meaning, used mainly to describe or analyze a certain object or a certain range.

columns.meaning: Taiwan and France are very different
using the internet is not only convenient

text.traditional: 就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同……
text.simplified: 就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同……
text.pinyin: Jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bùtóng……
text.english: As for election culture, Taiwan and France are very different……

words.meaning: Taiwan and France are very different

text.traditional: 就購物的方式來說，使用網路不僅方便，比價也容易多了。
text.simplified: 就购物的方式来说，使用网路不仅方便，比价也容易多了。
text.pinyin: Jiù gòuwù de fāngshì lái shuō, shǐyòng wǎnglù bùjǐn fāngbiàn, bǐjià yě róngyì duō le.
text.english: As for the way of shopping, using the internet is not only convenient, comparing prices is also much easier.

text.traditional: 就我們中文系的課程來說，不僅一學期比一學期難，報告也越來越多了。
text.simplified: 就我们中文系的课程来说，不仅一学期比一学期难，报告也越来越多了。
text.pinyin: Jiù wǒmen Zhōngwénxì de kèchéng lái shuō, bùjǐn yì xuéqī bǐ yì xuéqī nán, bàogào yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
text.english: As for the courses in our Chinese department, not only does each semester get harder than the last, there are also more and more reports.

items.question: How does 就……來說 differ from 對……來說?
items.answer: 就……來說 targets a specific objective domain or criteria ('in terms of X'). 對……來說 introduces an individual's personal subjective perspective ('to person X').
items.wrongTraditional: 對選舉文化來說，兩國很不同。
items.wrongSimplified: 对选举文化来说，两国很不同。

right.traditional: 就選舉文化來說，兩國很不同。
right.simplified: 就选举文化来说，两国很不同。
right.pinyin: Jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, liǎng guó hěn bù tóng.
right.english: In terms of election culture, the two countries are very different.

items.question: Can 來說 be replaced with 看 in this pattern?
items.answer: 來說 is standard in this written construction; do not use 看 or other verbs inside the frame.
items.wrongTraditional: 就這棟房子的環境來看說，還不錯。
items.wrongSimplified: 就这栋房子的环境来看说，还不错。

right.traditional: 就這棟房子的環境來說，還不錯。
right.simplified: 就这栋房子的环境来说，还不错。
right.pinyin: Jiù zhè dòng fángzi de huánjìng lái shuō, hái búcuò.
right.english: In terms of this house's environment, it's pretty good.

questions.prompt: Introduce a critique framed from the standpoint of product quality:
questions.correctFeedback: 就……來說 evaluates an objective domain or quality.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 就……來說 to scope analysis by a specific standard or domain.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: V / Vs + 得 + Result or Degree
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe how much or how far an action or state goes with V/Vs 得.
grammarPages.explanation: 「得」的後面是補語，說明「得」前面的動作(V)，或是前面的狀態(Vs)達到什麼樣的程度。「得」後面表示結果，可以使用誇張的詞語或短句加以說明。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Words after 得 ard complements. 得 explains the level of the action (V) or the state (Vs) in front of 得 to show the result. It can be expressed using exaggeration or short sentences.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 得 to show how far an action or state goes.

items.question: Which 得 particle connects verbs to degree complements?
items.answer: Use 得 (structural particle for complements), not 的 (noun modifier) or 地 (adverbial marker).

right.pinyin: Tā kāixīn de dàxiào le qǐlai.
right.english: He was so happy that he started laughing out loud.

items.question: Can V/Vs得 be followed by a full explanatory clause?
items.answer: Yes, it frequently introduces an exaggerated consequence clause like 我都站不起來了 or 沒時間吃飯.

right.pinyin: Tā máng de lián fàn dōu méi chīwán.
right.english: He was so busy that he didn't even finish his meal.
